items.title: 54270_Doc Cheatham oral history interview
items.q: I joined Sam Wooding as a lead trumpet player because Bobby Martin was the lead trumpet player

ctx.x: That must've been a very strange experience, coming from here with the situation the way it was here.

Oh, very -- oh yes. Yes. I thought that was the greatest thing in the world, the band. I jumped in that band and I was playing lead trumpet. That's the thing that [were] very important, money. I joined Sam Wooding as a lead trumpet player because Bobby Martin was the lead trumpet player and also did the jazz thing and it was too much for him, so I just joined the band as the lead trumpet player and then I stopped playing jazz altogether.
